title: Leek and Prawn Risotto
blurb: A creamy rice dish with tender leeks and prawns, finished with lemon and fresh herbs.
steps: Trim and slice the leeks into thin rounds, then wash thoroughly in cold water and drain. Peel and finely chop the garlic.
Heat the stock in a saucepan and keep it warm over a low heat throughout cooking.
Heat the olive oil and half the butter in a wide pan over medium heat, then add the leeks and cook gently for 8 minutes until softened. Add the garlic and cook for another minute.
Stir in the rice and cook for 2 minutes until the grains are coated and translucent at the edges. Pour in the wine and stir until absorbed.

Add a ladleful of warm stock and stir frequently until absorbed, then continue adding stock a ladleful at a time, stirring often, until the rice is creamy and tender but still has a slight bite, about 20 minutes.
Stir in the prawns and cook for 3 minutes until they turn pink and are cooked through.
Remove from the heat and stir in the remaining butter, grated parmesan, the juice of the lemon, and black pepper. Roughly chop the coriander and scatter over the top before serving.
